content: Study the past if you would define the future.
author: Confucius
explanation: Human nature remains remarkably constant across millennia. By mastering the triumphs and catastrophes of history, we gain the foresight required to navigate current uncertainties wisely.
practicalInsight: When facing a modern dilemma, consult how historical thinkers or classic texts navigated analogous crises.
reflectionPrompt: What recurring historical cycle are you currently observing in your personal or professional environment?
